name: Marcalgergelyi (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of light grey, green and light grey in the ratio 1:4:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Marcalgergelyi: a blue and yellow shield with a church, a sun and a green mound, with grey mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
